Safe Disposal of Legacy waste
(old municipal solid waste).
column3:
• For Safe disposal of Legacy Waste (old
municipal waste dump site), Model EOI has been
developed and provided to Muzaffarpur, Gaya
and Biharsharif Municipal Corporations in 1st
phase.
• EOI has been Published by all the three
municipal corporations and they are in the
process of finalizing it.

• Draft “Policy of Construction and Demolition
Waste Management” has been approved and
circulated among the concerned stakeholders for
suggestion and feedback.
• For establishment of C & D Waste Processing
Facility in the state, Expression of Interest (EOI)
has been released by all the Nagar Nigams.
• Work order issued by Patna Nagar Nigam to M/s.
National Federation of Farmers, Procurement
Processing Retailing Cooperatives of India Pvt.
Ltd. (NACOF).
• RFP published by Biharsharif Nagar Nigam
(Capacity-30 TPD) and Muzaffarpur Nagar
Nigam (Capacity-25 TPD) for establishment of C
& D waste management facility.
